Built a complete playable 3D mobile-friendly creature-collecting game called **Wildbound: Pocket Meadow**.

### Included
- 3D meadow world rendered with Three.js
- Playable player creature with:
  - Touch joystick controls
  - Keyboard controls: WASD
  - Movement boundaries
- Wild creature encounter system
- Capture flow with:
  - Wild encounter modal
  - “Toss a Lumi Ball”
  - “Wave Hello”
  - Creature joins party feedback
- Responsive phone/tablet UI
- Trainer profile, XP bar, rank, daily quest, streak counter
- Weather and compass widgets
- Bag modal with collectible items
- Map toast notification
- Sound toggle feedback
- Animated creatures, trees, flowers, fog, lighting, shadows, and environmental motion
- Responsive layouts for small screens

### Files added
- `index.html`
- `styles.css`
- `game.js`

### Checks completed
- JavaScript syntax validated
- Local server loaded successfully
- Desktop screenshot reviewed
- Encounter interaction screenshot reviewed
- Mobile-responsive layout styles included

Assumptions: I used original creature designs and placeholder-style 3D geometry rather than copyrighted Pokémon assets, and implemented a lightweight browser game without a build pipeline so it runs directly from the project folder.
